facts.fact: ANP reports that works on the Niger sections of the Trans-Saharan fibre-optic backbone (DTS/FO), financed at about 30 billion CFA francs by the AfDB, the ADF and national counterpart funds, began in 2021, and that the minister held provisional reception of fibre-optic sections on 14 November 2025.

systems.owner: Government of Niger (Ministry of Communication, Niger Telecom premises); AfDB-financed NEPAD project

note: Open access is only the minister's stated objective, not a stated fact; sections not stated as lit or which towns they link, so no in-service fact.
